title: Un mandado
desc: Being sent for tortillas, which means you are trusted
setting: Doña Carmen is at the stove and she has not turned around to ask you.

steps.speaker: Doña Carmen
steps.es: Mijo, ¿me hace un favor? Vaya a traer tortillas.
steps.en: Love, will you do me a favour? Go and fetch some tortillas.

options.feedback: Yes first, question second. A mandado is not really a request, and being asked is good news.
You are going, which is what she needed. You will be back on the doorstep asking how many.
The word for right now is going. Asking whether she means now reads as looking for a way out.

steps.speaker: Doña Carmen
steps.es: Ocho. Dígale a doña Chepa que son para mí.
steps.en: Eight. Tell doña Chepa they are for me.

options.es: Ocho, y que son para usted. Va pues.
options.en: Eight, and that they are for you. Right then.
options.feedback: You repeated the order back. Saying whose they are matters: doña Chepa will pick the good ones.

options.en: Eight tortillas. I will be right back.
options.feedback: The number is right and you left out her name, which was half the instruction.

options.es: ¿Y por qué le tengo que decir eso?
options.en: And why do I have to tell her that?
options.feedback: Because names carry weight in a barrio. You do not need the reason to carry the message.

steps.speaker: Doña Chepa
steps.en: Eight? And who are those for?

options.es: Para doña Carmen. Me mandó ella.
options.en: For doña Carmen. She sent me.
options.feedback: Me mandó ella is the sentence. It tells her whose house you are in and where you stand in it.
She will guess right. Naming doña Carmen would have got you the tortillas off the top of the stack.
Eight tortillas for one man will be talked about on this street until Thursday.

steps.speaker: Doña Carmen
steps.es: Gracias, mijo. Coma una, que está caliente.
steps.en: Thank you, love. Eat one, it is hot.

options.en: Thank you, doña. It is properly hot.
options.feedback: The tortilla is the wage. Taking it closes the errand properly.
Fine. Eating it in front of her would have been better than thanking her for it.

options.en: No, doña, they are for you.
options.feedback: Refusing the one she held out turns a favour into a transaction, which is the opposite of what happened.
